visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anime-style female character with fox ears and long black hair is presented as a monochrome line drawing on a stark white digital canvas. She looks directly at the viewer with a seductive expression, squinted eyes, and a slight smirk. Her arms are raised behind her head in a relaxed pose. A red rectangular logo and white Traditional Chinese text overlays are positioned at the bottom of the frame. (2) Flat colors are applied to the character's skin and hair, transforming the sketch into a basic color block illustration. The character's pose and expression remain constant as the coloring process progresses. The fox ears are filled with dark pigment. The lighting appears flat as the white background continues to serve as the environment. The text at the bottom remains visible and unchanged throughout this phase. (3) Sophisticated shading, highlights, and detail rendering are added to the character, giving her a more three-dimensional appearance. Her eyes are colored a vivid purple, and highlights are added to her black hair. Teal, swirling tentacle-like graphic elements appear around her torso. The background transitions to a textured greyish-white environment. The final rendered digital illustration is displayed prominently alongside the promotional text overlays.
